items.title: India seen kicking off rate hike cycle as inflation broadens, peers turn hawkish
items.author: Jaspreet Kalra
items.creator: Jaspreet Kalra
items.summary: Investors have loaded up on bets that the Reserve Bank of India will raise rates this week, warning that it risks falling behind the curve as inflation quickens, growth remains resilient and major central banks turn more hawkish.
items.body:
Investors have loaded up on bets that the Reserve Bank of India will raise rates this week, warning that it risks falling behind the curve as inflation quickens, growth remains resilient and major central banks turn more hawkish.
Nearly 60% of economists [USN:L4N45K09D TEXT:"polled"] by Reuters, 35 out of 61, expect a 25-basis-point rate hike at its policy meeting on Wednesday. Market pricing is more decisive with swap markets fully pricing in an increase in borrowing costs.
If delivered, the hike would be the RBI's first in nearly four years and lift the benchmark repo rate (INREPO=ECI) from 5.25% where it has remained for nearly 10 months. The Monetary Policy Committee cut rates by a cumulative 125 bps in 2025 from 6.5% to 5.25%.
"We now sense that the RBI has little reason to wait, given visibility of growth remains high, inflation appears to be broadening, and the need to wait for clarity on the global front declines," said Rahul Bajoria, India and ASEAN economist at BofA Global Research.
Bajoria expects the central bank to kick off a 100-basis-point tightening cycle in October with subsequent hikes penciled in for December and the first half of 2027.
"This essentially is no longer just about reversing the incremental cut that the RBI had delivered last December but actually taking away the monetary punchbowl before inflation risks become entrenched," he said.
With inflation running above the RBI's target and markets already pricing in higher borrowing costs, the central bank's decision and guidance are likely to shape expectations for the path of interest rates and capital flows.
A benign inflation backdrop early in the year had given the RBI room to wait even as the Iran war sparked a surge in oil prices, but inflationary [USN:L6N45K0J1 TEXT:"pressures have since broadened"] beyond food and fuel.
Consumer inflation picked up in August to 4.82%, above the RBI's 4% medium-term target for a third consecutive month, with prices across nearly half of the CPI basket rising at or above the target. The economy grew 7.8% in the April-June quarter.
HOLD MAY DRAW PUSHBACK Several major central banks, including the US Federal Reserve and Bank of Japan, have raised rates since the US-Israeli war on Iran began seven months ago. Traders and analysts now expect the RBI to follow suit, warning that a pushback may be in store if rates are maintained.
"A hold will not be taken positively by the currency market and even the long end of the bond market may face some pressure," said Vivek Rajpal, Asia macro strategist at JB Drax Honore, adding that the RBI will also need to signal openness to raising rates further if needed.
The rupee remains [USN:L4N45M0LB TEXT:"under pressure"] and is about 1% off record lows hit in May.
"India needs to act on multiple fronts and going to a neutral rate is part of the solution," he added, pointing to how inflation-adjusted interest rates in India remain quite low at a time when price pressures have deepened and global competition for capital has intensified.
Higher rates could also make Indian bonds more attractive to foreign investors at a time when domestic stocks continue to struggle without clear AI opportunities.
HIKE, BUT HOW MUCH? Economists at Nomura and Barclays have penciled in a shallow hike cycle of 25-50 bps while ANZ, BofA and Goldman Sachs anticipate between 75 and 100 bps of rate increases.
Swap markets are pricing about 100 bps worth of hikes over the next 12 months and about 140 bps over the next 24 months.
BofA's Bajoria reckons the RBI may not want to commit to a longer hiking cycle in October itself, but could be open to doing so in December.
That would put the focus on any changes to the RBI's inflation and growth forecasts, as well as whether it changes its "neutral" policy stance, for clues on how far policymakers are prepared to take the tightening cycle.
Goldman Sachs economists expect the stance could shift to "calibrated tightening" or "withdrawal of accommodation."

TOKYO, Oct 5 : Japan's service sector expanded at a weaker pace in September as business activity and new orders grew more slowly and earthquake disruption dampened demand, a business survey showed on Monday.
• The S&P Global final Japan Services Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) eased to 51.3 in September from a five-month high of 52.5 in August, a survey by S&P Global showed, worse than a flash reading of 51.6. The 50-mark separates growth from contraction.
• "PMI survey data pointed to a softer expansion of Japan's service sector as the third quarter drew to a close, with businesses signalling slower increases in business activity and new orders," said Annabel Fiddes, Economics Associate Director at S&P Global Market Intelligence.
• New orders rose for a 27th straight month, but the pace eased from August. S&P Global said stronger domestic demand continued to support sales, while new export business fell again at the second-sharpest rate since January 2021.

• Employment increased for a 13th consecutive month and at the fastest pace since February, the survey showed. Companies also reported the strongest rise in backlogs of work in seven months as they sought to expand capacity and fill vacancies.
• Input cost inflation eased to a six-month low but remained elevated by historical standards, with firms citing higher raw materials, oil, labour and food costs. Charges levied by service providers also rose again, though output price inflation softened from August.
• The broader Composite PMI, which includes both manufacturing and services, fell to 52.3 in September from 53.5 in August, its weakest since May.
• The Bank of Japan's quarterly "tankan" survey released on Thursday showed Japanese manufacturers' confidence hit an eight-year high over July-September but non-manufacturers' mood soured, painting a mixed picture of the economy.

items.summary:
Tim Hepher

items.body:
エアバス、納入遅延回復もＡ３３０の新たな品質問題に直面
9:30 配信

エアバスのロゴ。 6月15日、パリ近郊で撮影。REUTERS/Alice Sacco

Tim Hepher

[パリ ２日 ロイター] - 欧州航空機大手エアバスは、９月に７２機の航空機を納入した。前年同月の７３機にほぼ匹敵する。業界関係者が２日明らかにした。

確認されれば、アナリストが予想していた追跡可能な納入総数（６０機代半ばから後半）を上回る。ジェフリーズのアナリストらは６８機と推定していた。

ベストセラー機「Ａ３２１ｎｅｏ」の部品に関わる最近の製造上の不具合による影響をはじめ、エンジンやその他の部品の従来の不足など、システム全体の遅延がもたらす影響が懸念される中、今回予想外のペースの回復が見られた。

関係者によると、エアバスは準備間隔の短縮によるコスト増が見込まれるにもかかわらず、Ａ３２１ｎｅｏの納入を継続させるため航空会社に譲歩案を提示したという。

ただ年末の目標達成には、第４・四半期に過去最多の航空機を納入する必要がある。民間航空機部門のラーズ・ワグナー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は今週、約８７０機の目標達成に「非常に自信がある」と述べた。

業界関係者は今週、９月の実績は計画を下回る水準で終了する見込みで、最近の遅延蓄積の影響で合計２０機の納入が第３・四半期から第４・四半期にずれ込んだと指摘した。

一方エアバスは、今年初めに航空機の水平尾翼から工具が発見されたことを受け、Ａ３３０型機について異物の有無を確認するよう航空会社に助言したと明らかにし、これにより納入が遅れている。

この勧告は、今年後半に規制当局による命令が出る可能性を見越したもので、２０２１年１月から今年７月までに納入された機体が対象となるという。航空情報会社シリウムのデータによると、これには１５機のＭＲＴＴ軍用空中給油・輸送機を含む１６０機が該当する。

エアバスは追加点検に関するブルームバーグの報道を確認する声明で、現在生産ラインから出荷している全ての航空機は点検済みで納入可能だと述べた。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 米商品先物取引委員会（ＣＦＴＣ）の建玉明細によると、９月...
items.body:
投機筋の円買いが後退、レバレッジド・ファンドは売り越しに転換
9:28 配信

円紙幣。2024年7月3日、都内の貨幣博物館で代表撮影。REUTERS

Noriyuki Hirata

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 米商品先物取引委員会（ＣＦＴＣ）の建玉明細によると、９月２９日時点で投機筋（非商業部門）の円の買い越しは５万５４４０枚だった。４週連続の買い越しを維持したが、前週比１万６５４２枚減と、円高方向の持ち高を減らした。投資主体別に建玉を分けた金融先物建玉報告（ＴＦＦ）ではレバレッジド・ファンドが売り越しに転換した。

足元は「日米による円安是正の姿勢でいったん膨らんだ円の買い越しが、日米のタカ派姿勢の温度差を受けて、先週前半にかけて巻き戻された様子がうかがわれる」とニッセイ基礎研究所の上野剛志主席エコノミストは指摘する。非商業部門の差し引きの持ち高は、９月１日時点の９万２２２７枚の売り越しから、同１５日には１２万０３５９枚の買い越しへと、２週間で２１万２５８６枚、円買い方向に振れていた。

この振れ幅は、統計をさかのぼれる１９８６年以降で最大。１５日の買い建ては２３万７９５１枚、建玉残高も５４万２８０２枚で、いずれも過去最大だった。

その後の２週間で、買い越しは６万４９１９枚減り、減少ペースは直近１週間で鈍っている。１５日の買い越しからは半分強が戻ったが、９月１日の売り越し水準までは、なお１４万７６６７枚の開きがある。

ＴＦＦでは、ヘッジファンドなどで構成するレバレッジド・ファンドが前週の７４２３枚の買い越しから、１万４１６１枚の売り越しに転じた。一方、年金や投資信託などのアセットマネジャーは５万１６３４枚の買い越しと、前週から１万０００５枚買いを積み増し、向きが分かれた。

ニッセイ基礎研の上野氏は「両者とも９月初旬からは円買い方向だが、アセットマネジャーが円買いを維持している一方、レバレッジドファンドは足元で日米のタカ派温度差に着目して円買いの一部手仕舞いに動いているのではないか」との見方を示している。

items.title: フランス国債売り、ヘッジファンドが「大きな要因」＝フィデリティ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ロンドン ２日 ロイター] - フィデリティ・インターナショナルの債券部門最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）のマリオン・ルモルデ...
items.body:
フランス国債売り、ヘッジファンドが「大きな要因」＝フィデリティ
9:17 配信

パリの市場。9月10日撮影

[ロンドン ２日 ロイター] - フィデリティ・インターナショナルの債券部門最高投資責任者（ＣＩＯ）のマリオン・ルモルデック氏は２日、最近のフランス国債売りについて、欧州国債市場で存在感を増しているヘッジファンドが大きな要因になっているとの認識を示した。

ルモルデック氏は「現在のフランス市場では、ヘッジファンドの存在感が非常に大きくなっている。資金フローを見ると、現在のスプレッド（ドイツ国債に対するフランス国債の利回り上乗せ幅）の動きのうち、おそらく５０％はヘッジファンドの活動によるものだ」と述べた。

フランス国債は価格が急落し、利回りが上昇している。世界的な債券売りに加え、フランスの財政状況に対する懸念が強まり、投資家がより安全な欧州国債へ資金を移しているため。

ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、フランス１０年債利回りの対独上乗せ幅（スプレッド）は２日、１５０ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）に拡大した。両債のスプレッドは過去１週間で５０ｂｐ程度拡大し、週間ベースでは２０１１年１１月以来最大の上昇幅となる見通しだ。

ヘッジファンドは近年、欧州の国債市場で主要なプレーヤーとなっている。年金基金など従来型投資家が保有を減らしているためだ。ヘッジファンドは現在、欧州国債市場における取引活動の約半分を占めるとの推計もある。

ヘッジファンドは短期間での収益獲得を目指すことが多く、借り入れ資金を使って投資するケースも少なくない。そのため市場の値動きを増幅し、ボラティリティーを高める可能性がある。

ルモルデック氏は「フランスの情勢が危機的な状況に陥るとは懸念していない。しかし市場は政治情勢を見極めようとしているのは明らかだ。政治家に対して『財政運営には注意が必要だ』と警告を発している」と述べた。

欧州中央銀行（ECB）が緊急措置「トランスミッション・プロテクション・インスツルメント（TPI）」を使ってフランス国債市場の下支えに動く可能性についてルモルデック氏は「ＥＣＢが金融安定への脅威になると判断すれば、利用可能な手段を何でも使うだろう。ＥＣＢは市場参加者、とりわけヘッジファンドとも常に対話している」と述べた。

もっとも市場では、フランスがＥＣＢ支援の条件となる財政や財政赤字に関する主要基準を複数満たしていないため、現時点でＴＰＩ発動の可能性は低いとの見方が一般的だ。

items.summary: [東京 ５日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比１．１８％（８０４円２８銭）高の６万９１...
items.body:
日経平均は反発で寄り付く、米株高を好感　6万9000円回復
9:16 配信

東京証券取引所。2025年3月19日撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比１．１８％（８０４円２８銭）高の６万９１１３円７４銭と、反発してスタートした。前週末に公表された米雇用統計が弱い結果となり、今月の米利上げ観測が後退したことを受け、前週末の米国株は上昇。東京市場でも米株高の流れを引き継ぐ形で堅調な展開となり、日経平均は約１カ月半ぶりに６万９０００円を回復した。寄り付いた後も上げ幅を広げ、約１．９％（１３００円）高となっている。

セクター別では、電気機器、機械、ガラス・土石製品などが堅調。鉱業、パルプ・紙などは値下がりしている。

個別では、東京エレクトロン、ソフトバンクグループ、アドバンテストが上昇。ファーストリテイリングも堅調に推移。キオクシアホールディングスもしっかり。

主力のトヨタ自動車はしっかり、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループは小幅高で推移している。

items.title: Georgia block party shooting kills two, injures dozens
items.author: Svea Herbst-Bayliss
items.creator: Svea Herbst-Bayliss
items.summary: A shooting early on Sunday at a Georgia block party left two people dead and almost three dozen injured, some critically, local and state officials said.
items.body:
A shooting early on Sunday at a Georgia block party left two people dead and almost three dozen injured, some critically, local and state officials said.
Dooly County Sheriff Craig Peavy told a news conference that two men, aged 21 and 23, were shot dead in Vienna, Georgia, about 135 miles (216 km) south of Atlanta. Thirty-five people were injured, mostly by gunshot wounds, officials told reporters.
They said hundreds of people had attended the event, which came at the end of Dooly County High School's homecoming week.
Authorities do not believe there is a remaining threat to the public, but have not publicly named any suspects or persons of interest, and have not identified a motive for the shooting.
"We don't want to presume as to what caused it," said Chris Hosey, director of the Georgia Bureau of Investigation.
Those wounded range in age from 14 to 51, officials said.

items.title: ブルー・アウル、主力ファンドの7－9月解約請求減少　業界への圧力緩和か
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Arasu Kannagi Basil　Pritam Biswas

[２日 ロイター] - 米資産運用会社ブルー・アウ...
items.body:
ブルー・アウル、主力ファンドの7－9月解約請求減少　業界への圧力緩和か
9:02 配信

ブルー・アウル・キャピタルのロゴ。2026年2月、ニューヨークで撮影。 REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

Arasu Kannagi Basil　Pritam Biswas

[２日 ロイター] - 米資産運用会社ブルー・アウル・キャピタルの主力プライベートクレジットファンドで、７－９月期の解約請求が前期から減少したことが分かった。

同社が２日に公表した投資家向け書簡によると、傘下のファンド２本に対する７－９月期の解約請求額は計４２億ドルと、前期の４７億ドルを下回った。両ファンドはこうした商品で一般的な上限である発行済み株式の５％を買い戻す。

今回の解約請求の減少は、プライベートクレジット業界が解約圧力の最悪期を脱しつつある可能性を示す新たな手掛かりと言える。投資家心理が改善する一方、資産運用会社は過去に受け付けたものの実行できていない解約請求の処理を進められるようになった。

市場関係者は、一部の大手ファンドで未処理の解約請求がなお積み上がっているものの、請求額が減少方向にあることは前向きなサインだとみている。

プライベートクレジットファンドでは今年、融資審査基準への懸念や人工知能（ＡＩ）の普及がソフトウエア企業に及ぼす影響への警戒から、過去最高水準の解約圧力が高まった。ソフトウエア企業はプライベートクレジットの主要分野とされるダイレクトレンディングの主要な借り手だ。

もっとも資産運用会社の幹部らは、ファンドの実際の運用成績ではなく、プライベートクレジットに対する懸念が先行して解約を招いているとして、市場から過度に厳しく評価されていると主張している。

ブルー・アウルの主力ファンド「ブルー・オウル・クレジット・インカム（ＯＣＩＣ）」では、７－９月期の解約請求が発行済み株式の１６．８％となり、前期の１８．８％から低下した。ＯＣＩＣの運用資産は３５１億ドルで、非上場の事業開発会社（ＢＤＣ）として業界２位の規模を持つ。

ＯＣＩＣによると、新規の解約申し込みは引き続き限定的で、請求の大半は過去に処理されなかった投資家による再申し込みだった。

大手プライベートクレジットファンドは今年、一般的な５％の買い戻し上限を適用しているため、処理されなかった投資家が次回の買い戻しで再び申し込むことで、解約請求が高止まりする状況が続いている。

ブルー・アウルの経営陣はこれまで、同社商品の堅調な運用成績が非上場ファンドの解約請求減少につながっているとの見方を示していた。７－９月期の買い戻し申し込みは９月３０日に締め切られた。ＯＣＩＣなどのファンドは、運用資産の大部分が変動金利型であることから、金利環境が引き締まる局面で恩恵を受けやすいとみられている。

今年はプライベートクレジットファンドの運営を巡る否定的な報道をきっかけに投資家の不安が急速に高まり、業界の混乱の中心となったのがブルー・アウルで、傘下のファンド２本への解約請求は１－３月期に過去最高の５４億ドルに達していた。

エバーコアのアナリスト、グレン・ショア氏は「非上場ＢＤＣにとって、より長期的な問題は新規資金流入の鈍化だ」と指摘した。ダイレクトレンディングが顧客やアドバイザーの支持を取り戻すには時間がかかるとしながらも、業界はダイレクトレンディングを巡る問題の波及を抑えることに成功しており、ブルー・アウルのウェルス部門の他の商品は引き続き堅調だと付け加えた。

テクノロジー分野に特化した「ブルー・アウル・テクノロジー・インカム（ＯＴＩＣ）」では、解約請求が依然として業界平均を大きく上回った。株主構成が集中していることや、投資対象が専門的であることが背景にある。同ファンドではソフトウエア関連が運用資産の大きな割合を占める。

運用資産５０億ドルのＯＴＩＣでは、７－９月期に１１億ドルの解約請求があり、発行済み株式の３９％に相当した。前四半期は１１億ドル、３８．１％だった。

ＯＴＩＣの買い戻し請求も、ほとんどが過去に処理されなかった請求を投資家が再提出したものだった。

items.title: ＡＩ恩恵のため「ある程度悪いことも受け入れを」＝オープンＡＩトップ
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [４日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、ＡＩについて...
items.body:
ＡＩ恩恵のため「ある程度悪いことも受け入れを」＝オープンＡＩトップ
8:57 配信

オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマン最高経営責任者。9月29日、サンフランシスコで撮影。 REUTERS/Carlos Barria

[４日 ロイター] - 米人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業オープンＡＩのサム・アルトマン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、ＡＩについて「この技術の恩恵と、人々が主体性を持ち続けるためには、私たちは世界がある程度の悪い出来事を受け入れるべきだと考えている」との見解を示した。米政治専門ニュース「ポリティコ」のハイテク専門ニュースレター「デコーデッド」のインタビューで語った。

米アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は９月、高度なＡＩの開発ペースを緩めるように呼びかけ、アルトマン氏もこの立場を公に支持した。一方ＡＩへの規制を求める声に対してトランプ米大統領は米企業が中国企業と競争するのを困難にするとして一蹴している。

アルトマン氏は、ＡＩの規制に関してオープンＡＩとアンソロピックとの間には世界観で根本的な違いがあるとして「両社の間には大きな隔たりがあると思う」と説明。オープンＡＩは「より規制緩和的な姿勢」を支持すると説明した。

他方で「私は同意しないが、『この技術が極めて強力になり、非常に危険なため、米サンフランシスコのたった１つの研究所だけが保有し、悪いことが起きないように確実に管理し、その恩恵をどのように分配するかを考えるべきだ』という人々の視点については理解できる」とも表明。

ただ「『大規模なハッキングや技術の悪用、詐欺、その他のあらゆる悪事が一切起きないようにする』という取引には応じない」と訴えた。その理由として「なぜなら人々は悪事よりも、桁違いに多くの善行をすると信じているからだ」と主張した。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ５日 ロイター] - 日本ペイントホールディングスは５日、オランダの塗料メーカー、アクゾノーベルの東南アジア...
items.body:
日本ペイント、蘭アクゾの東南アジア事業を買収　2160億円
8:54 配信

2017年11月、東京にある日本ペイントホールディングスのオフィスで撮影。 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 ５日 ロイター] - 日本ペイントホールディングスは５日、オランダの塗料メーカー、アクゾノーベルの東南アジアの建築用塗料事業を１３億５０００万ドル（約２１６０億円）で買収することで合意したと発表した。アクゾの販売・製造・供給体制やブランド力を生かし、東南アジアの建築用塗料分野で競争力を高めたい考え。

買収対象はベトナム、インドネシア、マレーシア、シンガポールの事業で、タイ、オーストラリア、パプアニューギニアの建築用塗料事業も譲り受ける。株式取得や事業譲受は２０２７年半ばに終える見通しで、同買収による２０２６年１２月期業績への影響は軽微となる見通しとした。

日本ペイントは７月、アクゾの建築用塗料事業について総額７５億ユーロでの買収を提案していると明らかにしていた。ただ、アクゾはすでに米アクサルタ・コーティング・システムズと合併契約を結んでおり「代替提案」は受け入れられないとの立場を示していた。

日本ペイントはそれ以前にも、米シャーウィン・ウィリアムズ と共同でアクゾに買収を提案し、５月にアクゾが拒否した経緯があった。今回、東南アジアに対象を絞って買収にこぎ着けた。

items.title: Saudi Arabia unexpectedly cuts November oil prices to Asia to 6-year lows
items.author: Yomna Ehab, Siyi Liu
items.creator: Yomna Ehab, Siyi Liu
items.summary: Saudi Arabia unexpectedly cut its oil prices for sale to Asia in November to six-year lows while raising them for northwest Europe and the Mediterranean, a pricing document showed on Monday.
items.body:
Saudi Arabia unexpectedly cut its oil prices for sale to Asia in November to six-year lows while raising them for northwest Europe and the Mediterranean, a pricing document showed on Monday.
The largest Middle Eastern crude exporter set the November Arab Light crude oil official selling price to Asia at $5 a barrel below the average of Oman and Dubai prices, down $3 [USN:L1N44V0N1 TEXT:"from the previous month"]. The discount for November is the widest since June 2020, Reuters data showed.
This was against expectations of a hike of up to $5 a barrel for the November OSP in a [USN:L4N45K0F8 TEXT:"Reuters survey"], in line with gains seen in the Middle Eastern benchmarks.
State oil company Saudi Aramco (2222.SE) cut the November OSPs of heavier grades, Arab Medium and Arab Heavy, sold to Asia by $5 a barrel.
Aramco has been looking at offering [USN:L4N45K0Q6 TEXT:"discounts"] for oil loaded off Oman to compensate buyers for record freight rates, people familiar with the matter said last week, as it sought to protect its market share after disruptions from the US-Israeli war against Iran affected exports.
The OSP cuts appeared to be aimed at compensating buyers for the elevated freight costs, said three Asian refining sources who spoke on condition of anonymity.
The cost of booking a very large crude carrier capable of hauling 2 million barrels of oil from the Gulf to China on a time charter basis was $1.2 million a day on Friday, according to LSEG data. It was about $80,000 a day a year ago.
One of the sources also said the lower OSPs could offset the waiting time and longer voyage for Saudi oil exported from the Egyptian port of Sidi Kerir, where cargo loadings have been delayed.
Since September, Saudi Aramco has sold millions of barrels of crude through ship-to-ship transfers outside the Strait of Hormuz, pushing oil flows through the strategic waterway to pre-conflict levels.
The kingdom also [USN:L6N45L0WE TEXT:"resumed loading at the port of Yanbu"] on the Red Sea after a brief suspension as a drone attack shut its key East-West oil pipeline.
Separately, Saudi Aramco raised the November OSPs for northwest Europe by $3 a barrel across all grades.
Aramco kept prices unchanged for buyers in the United States.

items.body:
オープンＡＩ安全性担当者が退職、「試行錯誤の時代は終わった」
8:26 配信

オープンAIのロゴ。2023年2月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[３日 ロイター] - 米オープンＡＩを最近退職した元安全性担当者のデビッド・ロビンソン氏は、人工知能（ＡＩ）の安全性に対する同社の姿勢を批判した。開発スピードを重視する企業文化が失敗のリスクを高めていると主張した。

ロビンソン氏は３日、米誌アトランティックに掲載された「オープンＡＩの企業文化が壊れているから辞めた」と題する寄稿文で、 オープンＡＩを含むＡＩ企業は「十分に慎重とは到底言い難い」とし、より高性能なシステムを開発する前に、安全性に関する専門知識と研究をより重視すべきだと指摘した。

• 「試行錯誤の時代は終わった」と記し、高度なＡＩシステムには、原子力や航空などの産業で採用されているものに近い安全対策が必要だと主張した。

• ロビンソン氏はまた、オープンＡＩはシステムを公開し、問題が生じた際に安全対策を強化する「反復的な展開」と呼ぶ手法に大きく依存していると指摘した。

• 同氏の発言は、ますます強力になるシステムの開発を企業が急ぎすぎていないかというＡＩ業界内の議論に拍車をかけるものだ。

• ロビンソン氏はオープンＡＩに３年半在籍し、同社の「プリペアードネス・フレームワーク（備えの枠組み）」の策定に携わったほか、１２件の最先端モデル公開に伴う安全性報告書の作成を統括したと説明。「同社が次々と新製品のリリースを急ぐ中、私が必要と考える水準の慎重さを確保できていない」と記した。

• オープンＡＩの広報担当者は声明で「われわれは、モデルの能力が安全に管理・保護できる範囲を超えないようにしている。ペースを落とす必要がある場合には、学習を一時停止したり、モデルの公開を見合わせたりしている」と述べた。

9月29日、ワシントンで開催されたイベントに登壇するマスク氏。REUTERS/Kylie Cooper

[４日 ロイター] - 米宇宙開発企業スペースＸのイーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は４日、トランプ米大統領が「人工知能（ＡＩ）」の代わりに「スーパーインテリジェンス（ＳＩ）」という用語の使用を推進していることを受け、同社のＡＩ部門の名称を「スペースＸＡＩ」から「スペースＸＳＩ」に変更すると投稿した。

マスク氏はＸ上で、「スペースＸＳＩ」に改称する可能性について尋ねたユーザーに対し、「そのように変更する」と回答した。

• マスク氏は、スペースＸＡＩの名称変更に関する追加情報や、変更が行われる時期の見通しについては明らかにしなかった。

• 同社は改称に関するコメント要請に回答しなかった。

items.body:
伊政府、今年成長率見通し1％に上方修正　財政赤字は来年再びＥＵ基準超え
8:20 配信

4月22日、ミラノで撮影。 REUTERS/Claudia Greco

Giuseppe Fonte　Gavin Jones

[ローマ ２日 ロイター] - イタリア政府が２日公表した最新の２０２６年の実質国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）成長率見通しは１．０％で、４月時点の０．６％から上方修正した。今年の財政赤字は１９年以降で初めて欧州連合（ＥＵ）の基準内に収まるが、２７年には再び基準を上回ると見込んだ。

成長率見通しは、政府が今月まとめる２７年予算案の前提となる複数年の経済・財政予測の一環。ジョルジェッティ経済・財務相によると、２７年の成長率予想も従来の０．６％から０．８％に切り上がった。

ただ燃料価格の急騰でインフレが加速し、政府の資金調達コストも上昇しており、公的債務の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比は今年、ギリシャを上回ってユーロ圏２１カ国で最も高くなると想定されている。

ジョルジェッティ氏は記者会見で「状況を日々注視している。慎重に対応する必要がある」と述べた。

政府は２６年の財政赤字については、ＥＵが上限とするＧＤＰ比３％を下回る同２．９％に縮小する目標を維持した。２５年は３．１％で、基準内への復帰をわずかに逃していた。

一方２７年の財政赤字はＧＤＰ比３．４％と、従来目標の２．８％から大幅に引き上げた。ＥＵが加盟国に認める財政ルールの例外措置を活用し、防衛費を増やすほか、中東情勢の混乱を背景としたエネルギー危機への対応に財政支出を振り向ける。

巨額の公的債務が減少に転じる時期の見通しも２８年となり、４月時点から１年遅れる。公的債務のＧＤＰ比は２６年の１３８．１％から２７年に１３８．５％でピークを付け、２８年には１３７．９％へ低下するという。

ジョルジェッティ氏は、財政赤字の拡大によって２７年半ばにＥＵの財政規律上の是正手続きを終了する計画が妨げられないよう、欧州委員会と協議していることを明らかにした上で「今後２年間の財政赤字はＧＤＰ比３％を超えるが、防衛・エネルギー関連の追加支出を除いて調整する必要があり、その場合は３％を下回る」と説明した。

メローニ首相はこのほど、エネルギー価格上昇に伴うインフレへの対応を支援するため、財政ルールに「さらなる柔軟性」を設けるよう求める書簡をＥＵに送った。

items.body:
Home / World News / Trump confuses Brazil with India on prez election, says 125 million voted

Trump confuses Brazil with India on prez election, says 125 million voted In his Truth Social post, Trump praises the speed of Brazil's vote count but attributes the election to India, which does not directly elect its president

Representative Image: PTI

Unis Ahmad Dar New Delhi 3 min read Last Updated : Oct 05 2026 | 11:17 AM IST

Listen to This Article

Social media users on Monday were puzzled by a post from US President Donald Trump , where he mistook Brazil for India while commenting on the South American country's presidential election.
  In a post on Truth Social, Trump claimed that 125 million people had voted in the “first round of India’s Presidential Election,” praising the speed with which results were announced. The election he was referring to, however, was Brazil’s presidential election, held on Sunday.
  “125 Million People voted today in the first round of India's Presidential Election ,” Trump wrote, before turning the comparison into another attack on the US electoral system.
  Brazil, meanwhile, held the first round of its presidential election on October 4, with incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro emerging as the leading candidates. Neither secured enough votes for an outright victory, setting up a runoff on October 25, according to Reuters.
 

  Brazil's electronic voting system is known for delivering results rapidly, which was apparently the feature Trump wanted to highlight while making his case against the US voting system. More than 159 million Brazilians were eligible to vote in Sunday's election.

  Attempting to compare the US electoral system with the Brazilian election, Trump claimed that vote counts in Detroit, Philadelphia, California and other US cities and states can take weeks to be “calculated”, before declaring: “Voting in America is CORRUPT!!!”
  Although he did not name Brazil, the timing of the post and his reference to roughly 125 million voters closely match Sunday’s Brazilian presidential election, suggesting that the Brazilian vote was the example he intended to cite.

  Trump’s post invited reactions from social media with one user commenting, “Trump living in a different world? Is a presidential election taking place in India? President Donald Trump made the incorrect claim that 125 million people voted in India's "presidential election" today.”
  Another said, “This man is the president of the most powerful country in the world. This didn't happen by accident; he's done this before.” One more comment read: “Trump is suffering from India syndrome.”
  India does not hold a direct presidential election   India does not hold a direct presidential election. The Indian president is elected by an electoral college comprising elected members of Parliament and state legislatures, rather than through a nationwide popular vote. The next presidential election is not due in 2026.

US removes B-1 bombers from UK's Fairford air base amid security concerns

The planes' removal comes after several men were arrested on suspicion of a terror plot on the air base, with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham saying that Britain had "strong indications" that Iran was involved in the suspected plot targeting the base.

B‑1B Lancer bomber at the RAF Fairford airbase, which hosts US Air Force personnel, in Fairford, Gloucestershire, Britain, on Sep 27, 2026. (File photo: Reuters/Toby Shepheard)

FAST

NEW YORK: The United States removed its B-1 bombers from a UK air base one week after several men were arrested there on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts, a Pentagon official said on Sunday (Oct 4). 
A dozen B-1 bombers were stationed at RAF Fairford air base, located northwest of London. The planes had been used for US strikes on Iran. 
"While operational security precluded us from confirming the movement of our assets and forces in real-time, we can acknowledge now that all US bombers that were deployed to RAF Fairford have redeployed to their home stations in the United States," a Pentagon spokesman wrote in an email.
Britain has "strong indications" that Iran was involved in a suspected plot targeting the base, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Wednesday. Iran said accusations linking Tehran to the alleged plan were baseless and summoned the British ambassador in Tehran over the issue. 

The Wall Street Journal first reported that the aircraft were removed from the base amid security concerns over suspected terror plots against the facility.
The British government had allowed the US to use bombers based at Fairford to strike Iranian missile sites that were attacking ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
US President Donald Trump said those involved in the plot had planned "big damage", while US Secretary of State Marco Rubio also pointed to the "hands of a foreign actor".

items.title: NFL roundup: Cowboys' last-minute TD caps big 2nd half, upends Texans
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Javonte Williams ran for three touchdowns in the second half and CeeDee Lamb scored on his 17th reception of the game with 40 seconds remaining as the Dallas Cowboys collected a high-voltage 34-30 comeback victory over the host Houston Texans on Sunday afternoon.
items.body:
Javonte Williams ran for three touchdowns in the second half and CeeDee Lamb scored on his 17th reception of the game with 40 seconds remaining as the Dallas Cowboys collected a high-voltage 34-30 comeback victory over the host Houston Texans on Sunday afternoon.
Lamb posted a career-best 17 receptions and totaled 189 yards to help the Cowboys overcome a 10-point halftime deficit. Jason Witten (18 in 2012) is the only Dallas player to have more receptions in a game. Dak Prescott completed 32 of 45 passes for 335 yards and Williams had 62 yards on 19 carries for the Cowboys (2-2).
C.J. Stroud was 21-of-31 passing for 347 yards and two touchdowns for the Texans (0-4), who have lost their first four games for the first time since 2020. Nico Collins caught seven passes for 118 yards and two scores after a two-game absence due to a hamstring injury. Woody Marks rushed for a score.
Stroud guided the Texans on a nine-play, 87-yard drive to take a 30-27 lead with 2:23 left. The pivotal play was on third-and-14 from the Dallas 27-yard line. Stroud threw a short pass to Dalton Schultz at the 25. His lateral to David Montgomery was good for 19 more yards to the Cowboys' 6. Marks scored on the next play. Prescott then drove Dallas 74 yards on 11 plays, eventually connecting with Lamb for the winning points.
Patriots 29, Bills 26
Drake Maye completed 22 of 37 passes for 269 yards and three touchdowns, including a late, go-ahead TD pass to Efton Chism III, to lead New England over Buffalo in Orchard Park, N.Y.
Chism's leaping, one-handed 23-yard TD catch plus Maye's pass to Rhamondre Stevenson for the two-point conversion put the Patriots in front with 1:50 to play. Craig Woodson intercepted a Josh Allen pass at the New England 19-yard line on the ensuing possession, and the Patriots (2-2) were able to run out the clock and hand the Bills (3-1) their first loss in their new stadium.
Allen was 23-of-33 passing for 253 yards and one touchdown. Buffalo's Keon Coleman caught six passes for 116 yards and a TD. James Cook rushed for 75 yards and a score.
Ravens 24, Titans 18
Lamar Jackson threw for 222 yards and two touchdowns on 15-of-20 passing but exited early in Baltimore's home victory over Tennessee.
Jackson was sacked on the Ravens' final play of the second quarter by Jermaine Johnson II, who landed on Jackson's left ankle. Jackson was later seen on the sideline with his ankle wrapped. Tyler Huntley played the second half and completed 8 of 9 passes for 63 yards, but the Ravens (3-1) were held scoreless after taking a 24-7 lead to the half.
Cam Ward's 3-yard touchdown pass to Wan'Dale Robinson and two-point conversion pass to Gunnar Helm pulled the Titans (0-4) within six with 1:12 left. But Malaki Starks recovered Tennessee's ensuing onside kick with 1:10 left and Baltimore ran out the clock.
Rams 24, Eagles 20
Kyren Williams rushed for two late touchdowns to rally Los Angeles over Philadelphia on a soggy afternoon in Philadelphia. Williams scored from 1 yard out with 3:59 left and from 7 yards out with 1:10 remaining to lift the Rams.
Matthew Stafford overcame two first-half interceptions and finished with 317 yards on 32-of-51 passing for the Rams (2-2). Puka Nacua had a touchdown run to go with 125 yards on nine catches and Williams gained 147 yards (80 rushing, 67 receiving) from scrimmage. Byron Young sealed the win with two sacks on Philadelphia's final drive.
Jalen Hurts threw two touchdowns to Darius Cooper and Philadelphia (2-2) built a 20-10 lead by halftime, but the offense largely struggled after losing Saquon Barkley to an early hamstring injury and finished 0-for-12 on third-down conversions with only 172 yards of offense. Hurts completed 12 of 27 passes for 93 yards.
Jaguars 22, Bengals 17
Trevor Lawrence completed 18 of 23 passes for 227 yards and one touchdown to lead visiting Jacksonville past Cincinnati.
It was the first time Lawrence defeated Joe Burrow in four career meetings. Bhayshul Tuten ran 17 times for 73 yards while Chris Rodriguez Jr. added a 25-yard touchdown run for the Jaguars (3-1).
Burrow was 39-of-54 passing for 428 yards, a touchdown and two interceptions. Tee Higgins caught 11 passes for 157 yards while Chase Brown caught 11 passes for 71 yards for the Bengals (2-2), who played the second half without Ja'Marr Chase due to concussion symptoms.
Bears 23, Jets 12
Kyle Monangai rushed for 146 yards and two touchdowns and Tyson Bagent passed for 268 yards to boost host Chicago to a victory against New York.
Chicago (3-1) limited New York (1-3) to 157 total yards as the Jets lost their third game in a row. The Bears rolled up 492 yards of offense while collecting 34 first downs to the Jets' seven. Bagent finished 25-of-34 passing, Rome Odunze had six catches for 94 yards and Monangai finished with 30 carries.
Geno Smith connected with Isaiah Williams for a 58-yard touchdown pass for New York, which enjoyed a rare bright spot when safety Minkah Fitzpatrick picked off Bagent in the second quarter. That stopped a record drought of 21 games without an interception for the Jets, who snagged their first pick since Jan. 5, 2025.
Giants 36, Cardinals 24
Jameis Winston threw for 250 yards and three touchdowns as New York outlasted Arizona in East Rutherford, N.J.
The Giants (3-1) shrugged off a 14-3 deficit as Winston fired second-quarter touchdown passes to Malachi Fields and Malik Nabers (six catches, 112 yards). Winston's 11-yard strike to Theo Johnson with 1:44 left in the third erased Arizona's last lead.
Jacoby Brissett hit 21 of 35 passes for 166 yards, two yards and three interceptions. He drove the Cardinals (1-3) to the Giants' 2-yard line in the final minute trailing 30-24, but Deonte Banks picked off a fourth-down pass and returned it 98 yards for a score on the game's final play.
Colts 30, Commanders 13
Jonathan Taylor ran for two touchdowns, and the Colts pulled away in the fourth quarter to beat the undermanned Commanders in London.
Taylor finished with 95 yards and two touchdowns on 20 carries, as Indianapolis (2-2) made the most of their 257 yards. Quarterback Daniel Jones shrugged off a pair of early turnovers to complete 19 of 34 passes for 143 yards and an interception.
Washington (1-3) played most of the day with rookie Athan Kaliakmanis at quarterback after starter Marcus Mariota suffered a right knee injury in the first quarter and wasn't able to return. Kaliakmanis completed 15 of 33 passes for 186 yards with a touchdown and an interception.
Packers 17, Buccaneers 14
Jordan Love threw for 197 yards and two touchdowns as Green Bay held on against Tampa Bay in Tampa, Fla.
Matthew Golden and Tucker Kraft caught 2-yard touchdown passes from Love as the Packers (2-2) never trailed. Evan Williams and Edgerrin Cooper picked off passes and Trey Smack booted a 58-yard field goal to give Green Bay a 10-7 halftime lead.
For Tampa Bay (0-4), rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels hit 19 of 27 passes for 148 yards and rushed for 55 yards in his first start playing for the injured Baker Mayfield (thumb). Sean Tucker rushed for a touchdown and Kenneth Gainwell caught a 10-yard touchdown pass to cut the Packers' lead to 17-14 with 14:49 to play.
49ers 24, Broncos 14
Deebo Samuel and Christian McCaffrey scored 1-yard touchdowns, George Kittle took a screen pass 56 yards for a clinching score and San Francisco remained unbeaten with a victory over Denver in Santa Clara, Calif.
Eddy Pineiro contributed a 24-yard field goal and linebacker Dre Greenlaw, who played last season for the Broncos, led a strong San Francisco defensive effort with 12 tackles, helping the 49ers open the season with four consecutive wins for the second time in the past four years.
Bo Nix went 25-for-42 for 214 yards, connecting 10 times with RJ Harvey for 68 yards for the Broncos (2-2). J.K. Dobbins had 40 of Denver's 82 rushing yards.
Seahawks 30, Chargers 23
Emanuel Wilson scored two touchdowns and Seattle held off a late rally to defeat visiting Los Angeles.
Wilson rushed 21 times for a game-high 81 yards and a touchdown and made three receptions for 39 yards and another score for the Seahawks (3-1), who held a 27-6 lead early in the third quarter. Sam Darnold was 13-of-22 passing for 168 yards and two scores for Seattle and Jaxon Smith-Njigba had five catches for 76 yards.
Justin Herbert completed 19 of 31 passes for 189 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions for the Chargers (0-4), who committed four turnovers. The teams combined for 30 penalties, the most in an NFL game this season.
Vikings 15, Dolphins 10
T.J. Hockenson had a career-high-tying 13 receptions and gained 119 yards and Minnesota improved to 4-0 for the 11th time in franchise history with the win over Miami in Minneapolis.
Will Reichard matched his career best of five field goals and Kyler Murray completed 27 of 37 passes for 247 yards for the Vikings. Aaron Jones Sr. finished with 128 all-purpose yards (94 rushing, 34 receiving).
Ollie Gordon II had nine carries for 100 yards and a touchdown to lead Miami (0-4). Malik Willis completed 9 of 17 passes for 85 yards and lost a fumble.
Chiefs 30, Raiders 27
Patrick Mahomes, Kenneth Walker III and Kansas City planted their flag atop the AFC West with a 30-27 victory over host Las Vegas.
Walker III had 22 carries for 177 yards and two touchdowns. Mahomes won his 99th regular-season game and threw two TD passes to wide receiver Tyquan Thornton, who exited with a leg injury. Wideout Rashee Rice also left the game with a first-quarter injury. The Chiefs (4-0) enter their bye week as the last undefeated team in the AFC.
After Kansas City scored two fourth-quarter touchdowns in a 19-second span, Kirk Cousins (365 passing yards, two TDs) led a touchdown drive for the Raiders to cut the deficit to 30-27 with 1:46 left. Las Vegas' (3-1) would-be game-winning drive ended on his lone interception in the closing seconds.
Panthers 32, Lions 26
Carolina's Bryce Young threw two touchdown passes to Tetairoa McMillan and the injury-riddled Panthers defense limited Detroit to two touchdowns in a win in Charlotte.
Chuba Hubbard racked up 122 rushing yards and a pair of touchdowns on 20 carries for the Panthers (2-2). Young completed 29 of 41 passes for 329 yards. McMillan's 14 receptions accounted for 192 yards.
Jared Goff was 32-for-52 passing for 412 yards and one touchdown for the Lions (2-2). Jameson Williams made six receptions for 102 yards. Jake Bates kicked field goals from 54, 43, 41 and 26 yards.
--Field Level Media

Oct 4 : OpenAI Chief Executive Sam Altman said the benefits of artificial intelligence justify accepting some risks and argued the technology should remain broadly accessible to the public
"We believe that the world should accept some bad things happening for the benefits of this technology and people having the agency," Altman said in an interview with Politico's technology-focused newsletter Decoded.
Altman said there remained a fundamental difference in worldview between OpenAI and rival Anthropic on AI regulation, adding: "I think there's a lot of daylight."
"I disagree, but I understand the perspective of people who are like, 'This technology is going to get so powerful, and it's so dangerous, that a single lab in San Francisco should have it and make sure nothing bad happens, and kind of figure out how to dole out the benefits,'" Altman said.

He called that "a completely unacceptable trade-off" that runs counter to the "lighter-touch regulatory stance" backed by OpenAI.
"I wouldn't take a trade of saying, 'We'll make sure there's no major hacks, there's no misuse of this technology, there's zero scams, there's zero all the other bad things that will happen,'" Altman said. "Because I think people will do tremendously — orders of magnitude more — good stuff than bad stuff."
Altman's remarks come amid a growing debate within the AI industry over the pace of development and the risks posed by increasingly capable systems.
Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei in September published an essay calling on the industry to slow down to "pace the frontier," a stance that Altman publicly endorsed. Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned in September, saying the people building AI believe it "could kill us all by the end of the decade.
Reuters reported in September that Anthropic warned that, despite AI's potential benefits, the technology can sometimes act in ways that run counter to its makers' intentions and penetrate other companies' systems. The company said advanced models could exhibit "self-preserving behaviors," including attempts to "resist shutdown," "conceal or manipulate information," or generate outputs that could be interpreted as "coercive, deceptive, or manipulative."
However, US President Donald Trump has largely dismissed calls for new restrictions, arguing they would make it harder for American companies to compete with Chinese rivals. He has repeatedly said existing law enforcement agencies, including the Justice Department, provide sufficient safeguards and that no new rules are needed.

items.title: Chiefs WRs Rashee Rice, Tyquan Thornton suffer injuries
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Kansas City Chiefs wide receivers Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton were injured during Sunday's game at Las Vegas.
items.body:
Kansas City Chiefs wide receivers Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton were injured during Sunday's game at Las Vegas.
Rice suffered a hamstring injury after corralling a first-down pass from Patrick Mahomes in the right flat during the first quarter of the Chiefs' 30-27 win. Rice had room to run but limped toward the sideline and out of bounds at the Kansas City 36 after a five-yard gain. Rice remained on the sideline, stretching and chatting with Chiefs vice president of sports medicine and performance Rick Burkholder. He didn't return to the game.
Thornton suffered a gruesome left ankle injury in the fourth quarter after reeling in a 55-yard pass from Mahomes. Treydan Stukes tackled Thornton from behind and the two got twisted as they fell to the ground. Thornton celebrated the catch by raising his right arm toward the stands. But he crumbled to the ground as soon as he tried to stand, and his left ankle was twisted in the other direction.
"It doesn't look good," Chiefs coach Andy Reid said of Thornton's injury, adding he expects him to be back in Kansas City with the team.
NFL Network reported later Sunday night that Thornton sustained a dislocated ankle that was put back in place by doctors and will be evaluated on Monday. He is out indefinitely, per the report.
With the Chiefs' receiver depth taking a few hits, ESPN reported that Kansas City has remained in contact with former Chiefs wideout Tyreek Hill and his agent Drew Rosenhaus about a potential reunion.
Hill, 32, was released by the Dolphins in February as a salary-cap-reduction measure after he sustained a dislocated left knee and tore ligaments in his knee last September, ending his season after just four games.
Hill played his first six seasons in Kansas City from 2016-21, catching 479 passes for 6,630 yards and 56 touchdowns, earning six Pro Bowl nods and three first-team All-Pro honors.
"It's almost time to get off the couch and get to work," Hill posted on his X account last week as he nears full health after an extensive recovery process.
--Field Level Media

items.summary: [４日 ロイター] - オランダの塗料メーカーのアクゾノーベルが、東南アジアの建築用塗料事業を日本ペイントホールディ...
items.body:
蘭アクゾ、東南アジア事業を日本ペイントに10億ドル超で売却へ＝ＦＴ
7:24 配信

2024年6月、英マンチェスターのホームセンターに並べられたアクゾノーベルの製品。 REUTERS/Phil Noble

[４日 ロイター] - オランダの塗料メーカーのアクゾノーベルが、東南アジアの建築用塗料事業を日本ペイントホールディングスに１０億ドルを大幅に上回る金額で売却する契約の合意に近づいている。英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）が４日、事情に詳しい関係者の話として報じた。

早ければ５日にも合意に達する可能性があるという。売却対象には、ベトナム、インドネシア、マレーシア、タイ、シンガポールに加え、パプアニューギニアおよびオーストラリアにおける建築用塗料事業が含まれる。

アクゾノーベルと日本ペイントは、ロイターのコメント要請に回答していない。

両社は７月、日本ペイントがアクゾノーベルの建築用塗料事業について総額７５億ユーロでの買収に向け複数の提案を提出したと発表した。ただ、アクゾノーベルはすでに米アクサルタ・コーティング・システムズと合併契約を結んでおり「代替提案」は受け入れられないとの立場を示していた。

ＦＴによると、日本ペイントは建築用塗料事業に関するより大規模な取引に引き続き関心を示しているものの、東南アジア事業の統合にはしばらく時間を要すると見込まれており、アクゾノーベルは同事業からさらなる資産を売却する計画はないという。

items.title: Oil slips as Middle East crude exports rise, G7 to release stocks
items.author: Florence Tan
items.creator: Florence Tan
items.summary: Brent crude futures climbed to $103.06 a barrel.
items.body:
Oil prices edged lower on Monday as rising Middle East crude exports and a release of oil stocks by the Group of Seven nations boosted supplies, offsetting concerns about further damage to Gulf oil infrastructure amid the US-Israeli war on Iran.
Brent crude futures fell 66 cents, or 0.65%, to $101.59 a barrel at 0240 GMT, while US West Texas Intermediate crude was at $90.12 a barrel, down 95 cents, or 1.03%.
Brent gave up most of its gains last week while WTI was 1.6% lower after [USN:L6N45O0G5 TEXT:"G7 countries"] agreed on Friday to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude from emergency reserves and pledged to refrain from energy export restrictions after pressure from US President Donald Trump.
The release will add to [USN:L1N45R00B TEXT:"Middle Eastern crude exports"] which rose above pre-war levels in four of the seven days of the final week of September, shipping data showed on Monday, despite attacks on vessels passing through the Strait of Hormuz.
"The G7 decision to tap strategic reserves is taking some of the immediate supply anxiety out of the price, while there's a growing view that Saudi export volumes are moving back toward pre-war levels, even if those barrels are still moving at higher cost and via less efficient routes," said Tim Waterer, chief analyst at KCM Trade.
"That combination is enough to subdue prices for now even though the risks of further damage to energy infrastructure around the Gulf region haven't gone away."
The Houthis said they [USN:S8N441065 TEXT:"launched"] ballistic missiles and drones at Saudi Aramco sites in Riyadh and the Khurais area of Saudi Arabia in response to 50 Saudi-led air and missile strikes in Yemen in the past 12 hours. There was no confirmation from Saudi Arabia.
On Sunday, Yemen's Saudi-backed, internationally recognised government said it was launching a major [USN:L1N45Q02D TEXT:"military campaign"] to recapture all areas of the country controlled by the Iran-backed Houthis. Meanwhile, Aramco has [USN:L1N45Q05Y TEXT:"unexpectedly cut"] November crude oil prices for Asia to six-year lows.
Brent prices continue to stay above $100 per barrel on persistent geopolitical tensions and an increase in attacks on commercial vessels in the Gulf, ING analysts said in a note.
Meanwhile, [USN:L6N45O0QD TEXT:"OPEC+ delayed"] a review that would determine 2027 oil output quotas for its members after the Iran war disrupted projects to expand capacity across the Middle East, throwing estimates of future production potential into uncertainty, said two sources close to the matter.
In Europe, [USN:L1N45Q01Z TEXT:"Ukraine"] will double down on attacking Russian oil refineries, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy told Reuters in an interview published on Saturday.

items.title: US monitoring suspected fatal pneumonic plague case in Russia, says State Department official
items.summary: The US State Department is monitoring unverified reports of a fatal pneumonic plague case in Siberia's Irkutsk Oblast. Urging Moscow to share accurate information quickly, officials note that the ...
items.body:
US monitoring suspected fatal pneumonic plague case in Russia, says State Department official  The US State Department is monitoring unverified reports of a fatal pneumonic plague case in Siberia's Irkutsk Oblast. Urging Moscow to share accurate information quickly, officials note that the disease can be treated with common antibiotics if caught early.
ANI | Updated: 05-10-2026 10:33 IST | Created: 05-10-2026 10:33 IST

Representative Image (Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

The US State Department is actively monitoring unverified reports concerning a suspected fatal case of pneumonic plague originating within Russia, prompting an official appeal directed towards Moscow to promptly release precise information. Speaking anonymously to Fox News, a State Department official confirmed that Washington remains cognisant of the reported fatality located in Irkutsk Oblast, a territory situated in southeastern Siberia. The official noted that the situation is being closely observed in tandem with the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), alongside additional federal bodies, while emphasising that numerous particulars continue to lack official verification and urging Russian authorities to disclose all known facts.
Dan Hoffman, a former Central Intelligence officer, told Fox News Digital that the American intelligence apparatus is likely gathering comprehensive, multi-source intelligence pertaining to the incident. “I would also expect our embassy in Moscow to be engaging with their diplomatic counterparts at an official level because we might have people in Russia who might be at risk,” Hoffman warned.
“Washington will be speaking to all of our allies and partners in the region and sharing what we know.” According to the State Department official, pneumonic plague remains manageable through standard antibiotic regimens, particularly when therapeutic intervention commences during the early stages of infection. The CDC indicates that proper medical protocols ought to be initiated immediately upon suspected exposure, utilising either intravenous or oral antimicrobials contingent upon the illness's severity and additional clinical factors.
Furthermore, the official observed that occurrences of pneumonic plague manifest naturally across multiple global regions. Reaffirming that the protection and welfare of American nationals abroad constitutes a paramount institutional objective, the department encouraged citizens journeying internationally to register via the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP) to obtain timely advisory updates. (ANI)

items.title: Britain set to levy tariffs on Chinese electric cars, The Times reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Britain is considering imposing tariffs on Chinese electric vehicle imports amid concerns that Beijing is flooding the market with state-subsidised cars, the Times newspaper reported on Sunday.
items.body:
Britain is considering imposing tariffs on Chinese electric vehicle imports amid concerns that Beijing is flooding the market with state-subsidised cars, the Times newspaper reported on Sunday.
Business minister Jonathan Reynolds is drawing up a package of potential tariffs on Chinese vehicle imports, the report said, citing concerns that Chinese manufacturers are "dumping" subsidised vehicles into Britain.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
Asked to comment, a spokesperson from the British government told Reuters no tariffs have been imposed on Chinese EVs.
"We continue to engage closely with industry so that our approach reflects the sector’s and UK’s national interests," the spokesperson said in an email.
British ministers are ready to match the European Union's 45% levy on Chinese electric cars, the Times said, to avoid the pain of "Made in Europe" proposals, which could impact UK companies selling into the EU.
The EU's "[USN:L8N42K09E TEXT:"Made in Europe"]" policy is aimed at reducing reliance on Chinese components by prioritising European-made goods, raising concerns among British automakers that supply parts into European manufacturing chains and sell vehicles across the bloc.
Burnham [USN:L8N45E0EA TEXT:"said"] last month he would make the case that Britain should be treated as a "trusted partner" under the proposed EU rules, warning that excluding the UK could damage its car industry.
The Financial Times reported in September [USN:FWN45G1EO TEXT:"that Brussels had urged"] British Prime Minister Andy Burnham to align more closely with EU trade policy and raise tariffs on Chinese cars if Britain wants to avoid the "made in Europe" barriers.
According to the Times, citing senior government sources, ministers believe any decision on tariffs should be based on Britain's national interest rather than automatically following the EU's lead.

items.title: US removes B-1 bombers from UK base amid security concerns
items.author: Svea Herbst-Bayliss
items.creator: Svea Herbst-Bayliss
items.summary: The United States removed its B-1 bombers from a UK air base one week after several men were arrested there on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts, a Pentagon official said on Sunday.
items.body:
The United States removed its B-1 bombers from a UK air base one week after several men were arrested there on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts, a Pentagon official said on Sunday.
A dozen B-1 bombers were stationed at RAF Fairford air base, located northwest of London. The planes had been used for US strikes on Iran.
"While operational security precluded us from confirming the movement of our assets and forces in real-time, we can acknowledge now that all US bombers that were deployed to RAF Fairford have re-deployed to their home stations in the United States," a Pentagon spokesman wrote in an email.
Britain has "strong indications" that [USN:L1N45M0MW TEXT:"Iran was involved"] in a [USN:L1N45O076 TEXT:"suspected plot"] targeting the base, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said on Wednesday. Iran said accusations linking Tehran to the alleged plan were baseless and summoned the British ambassador in Tehran over the issue.
The Wall Street Journal first reported that the aircraft were removed from the base amid security concerns over suspected terror plots against the facility.
The British government had allowed the US to use bombers based at Fairford to strike Iranian missile sites that were attacking ships in the Strait of Hormuz.
US President [USN:L8N45K0CX TEXT:"Donald Trump said those involved in the plot"] had planned "big damage" while US Secretary of State Marco Rubio also pointed to the "hands of a foreign actor."

items.title: Flydubai's Omani co-pilot surveyed Ben Gurion airport multiple times, planned to crash plane: Israeli media
items.summary: An Omani co-pilot attempted to crash a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv on September 30. Passengers and off-duty pilots subdued the attacker and landed safely in Saudi Arabia. Authorities in the ...
items.body:
Flydubai's Omani co-pilot surveyed Ben Gurion airport multiple times, planned to crash plane: Israeli media An Omani co-pilot attempted to crash a Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv on September 30. Passengers and off-duty pilots subdued the attacker and landed safely in Saudi Arabia. Authorities in the UAE, Israel, and Australia are investigating his extremist background and potential terror ties.
ANI | Updated: 05-10-2026 09:45 IST | Created: 05-10-2026 09:45 IST

Representative Image (File Photo/Reuters). Image Credit: ANI

SHARE

Key Takeaways
AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Hamam al-Hammami, the Omani co-pilot behind the September 30 terrorist attack aboard Flydubai Flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv, had planned to direct the airliner into Ben Gurion Airport, according to reports published on Sunday by The Times of Israel. Currently detained and undergoing interrogation within the United Arab Emirates, al-Hammami informed investigators that his plan involved operating the flight in a routine manner after incapacitating the captain, securing all mandatory landing clearances, and subsequently crashing into an airport facility or stationed aircraft, as detailed by Hebrew media sources cited by The Times of Israel.
By deferring action until the final phase, he calculated he could preclude anyone from recognising the unfolding situation, sounding alarms, or obstructing his objective. According to The Times of Israel, that consideration accounted for why al-Hammami delayed seizing control of the flight deck until the aeroplane traversed Jordanian airspace.
His actions were thwarted when Captain Smit Machchhar, despite suffering an assault and stab wounds from al-Hammami, succeeded in unlatching the cockpit portal, allowing a group of Israeli travellers to grapple with and restrain the assailant, while an individual among them steadied the aircraft prior to two off-duty aviators stepping in to assume command of the controls. Reports cited by The Times of Israel indicated that al-Hammami had visited Ben Gurion Airport on multiple occasions during preceding months following flight duties with flydubai.
He disclosed to interrogators that during his June arrival, his entire focus concentrated on gathering intelligence and mapping out the assault. He subsequently scheduled the operation for July, though ultimately aborted the initiative at the final juncture due to a personal friendship with a member of the cabin crew.
Israeli security personnel have not directly interrogated al-Hammami themselves, with the intelligence being transmitted to Israel via Saudi and Emirati investigative channels, as noted by The Times of Israel. Israel has requested that the UAE broaden its questioning parameters to encompass flight attendants, according to Channel 12 reporting conveyed via The Times of Israel.
Meanwhile, Channel 13 reported, as cited by The Times of Israel, that al-Hammami told investigators, “I looked into which airline flies to Tel Aviv. That’s why I chose flydubai. I planned it even before I was accepted.” An earlier account published by the Italian newspaper Corriere della Sera indicated that al-Hammami intended to strike a skyscraper, drawing upon Israeli intelligence assessments, as reported by The Times of Israel.
According to that account, which outlined a chronological sequence of events, al-Hammami requested a prayer break at 9:15 am before launching an assault on the pilot using the flight deck's crash hatchet, sparking a violent confrontation as Machchhar fought to unlock the door from within. Around 9:20 am, Tali Manes accompanied her five-year-old child to the washroom area, where she began overhearing the altercation transpiring inside the cockpit.
She alerted an off-duty aviator seated within business class. The off-duty captain manipulated the exterior handle as Machchhar managed to release the latch, opening the entryway to expose al-Hammami striking the pilot, the documentation stated.
“He’s killing the pilot,” Manes shouted. Recognising that his initial objective was no longer viable, al-Hammami initiated a steep dive at 9:21 am targeting the desert floor, alongside efforts to fracture the guidance mechanisms to hinder any alternative attempts to stabilise the airframe, the overview noted.
Nevertheless, several Israeli passengers forced entry into the cockpit, overpowering the perpetrator and levelling the aircraft. Initially, off-duty aviators who intervened to pilot the transport broadcast the 7700 code, signifying a general emergency, at 9:31 am, according to the report. By 9:35 am, al-Hammami had been subdued, and by 9:38 am, the replacement flight crew altered the transponder signal to the more specific 7500 designation, denoting unlawful cockpit intrusion, Corriere della Sera conveyed, in coverage highlighted by The Times of Israel.
Saudi air traffic management instructed the aviators to execute an unscheduled touchdown in Tabuk, with the commercial jet making contact with the runway at 10:57 am. The transport carried approximately 180 passengers, predominantly Israeli nationals, alongside the flight crew.
The travellers returned home late Wednesday via a chartered repatriation service departing from Saudi Arabia, a nation maintaining no formal diplomatic ties with Israel, while Machchhar and al-Hammami were sent back to the UAE, with Machchhar receiving medical care and the perpetrator facing formal questioning. Separately, the Ynet news site quoted a senior Emirati source indicating that al-Hammami faces the prospect of capital punishment, as referenced by The Times of Israel.
The briefing noted that authorities in Abu Dhabi intend to seek the most severe sentence available. It additionally highlighted that Israeli intelligence representatives operated within the United Arab Emirates to participate in the examination of al-Hammami, who holds Omani nationality, according to The Times of Israel.
Building on these investigative developments, preliminary Israeli intelligence assessments conveyed to CBS News by individuals acquainted with the situation indicated that the reported hijacking attempt likely constituted a lone-wolf operation. The inquiry remains actively ongoing, with authorities exploring every prospective angle, those knowledgeable sources disclosed to CBS News.
Expanding on the timeline, the Wednesday commercial journey operating from Dubai to Tel Aviv neared Israeli airspace when the co-pilot allegedly attacked the flight captain and sought to direct the airframe downward in a crash, statements from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, individuals travelling on the aircraft, and the flight captain confirmed. The captain managed to resist the co-pilot long enough to release the flight deck portal.
Subsequently, a collective of Israeli passengers alongside FlyDubai personnel subdued the co-pilot, while two off-duty aviators present onboard successfully secured command of the aircraft to execute the emergency landing in Tabuk. The co-pilot currently remains within the United Arab Emirates, undergoing a subsequent phase of questioning following initial interrogations by Saudi officials when the airliner touched down.
Israel has dispatched its own delegation to the UAE to take part in the ongoing inquiry, as noted by CBS News. President Trump indicated on Thursday that the co-pilot could maintain connections to Iran, remarking to CBS News, “based on what I'm hearing.”
“We're working on it right now,” Mr. Trump stated to CBS News. “They're being very open with us. I would say the answer, based on what I'm hearing, is yes. But we're working on it right now.”
Netanyahu communicated to CBS News on Wednesday that the underlying motivations driving the co-pilot remain undetermined. “I don't think it was a hijacking,” Netanyahu informed “CBS Evening News” anchor Tony Dokoupil, supplementing that, as reported by CBS News, “I think it looks like a suicide attempt.”
During a Thursday interview, Netanyahu revealed that Israeli authorities established the co-pilot “underwent Islamist radical indoctrination,” drawing upon “personal information” compiled via ongoing interrogations, according to CBS News. He withheld further specifics regarding the alleged radicalisation, though he informed interviewers that the assailant appeared “suicidal,” noting that after other crew members and passengers restrained him, he shouted, “Kill me, kill me!”
Public identification of the flight's co-pilot revealed that his legal name is Hamam al Hamami, multiple sources close to the investigation communicated to CBS News. Al Hamami maintained a brief tenure with Oman Air, participating in junior pilot instruction.
Surveillance conducted by Omani state authorities revealed he accessed extremist online portals, informants noted to CBS News, prompting Oman Air to reassign him to administrative duties. An insider reported to CBS News that the pilot tendered his resignation from Oman Air subsequent to his reassignment to desk responsibilities, departing the carrier around 2024.
According to sources cited by CBS News, al Hamami previously uploaded digital video footage showcasing El Al Israeli Airlines aircraft stationed in Dubai, concluding the clip with an image depicting Ayman al-Zawahiri, the prominent al Qaeda commander eliminated via an American drone strike in 2022. Al Hamami subsequently relocated to Dubai, where FlyDubai recruited him without conducting background verification checks through Omani state channels, informants explained to CBS News.
Although holding Omani citizenship, al Hamami was not born in Oman, the sources stated to CBS News, adding that he spent the majority of his upbringing outside the nation, with his maternal heritage rooted in Syria and his paternal lineage in Oman. Omani state representatives have refrained from formally verifying his nationality in public forums, while insiders suggested to CBS News that dual citizenship status remains a possibility, as such a factor might clarify how he secured authorisation to pilot flights entering Israel.
Further details emerging from international investigations, reported by outlets including The Wall Street Journal and CNN, reveal that following the emergency landing, investigators discovered al-Hammami confessed to interrogators that his intention was to deliberately bring down the flight and that he was “not afraid of death.” The 29-year-old Omani national is being probed regarding how he underwent radicalisation and managed to re-enter a commercial cockpit despite extremist affiliations that had previously drawn official scrutiny.
Authorities across the United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, and Israel are actively investigating whether he operated independently or maintained external ties to foreign entities, with particular focus directed toward Iran. According to the WSJ, al-Hammami’s initial employer, the state-owned carrier Oman Air, barred him from flight duties after discovering his visits to extremist websites, and individuals briefed on his background indicated he subsequently completed a deradicalisation programme before joining FlyDubai in February 2026.
Investigators are also scrutinising his background in Syria, evaluating whether his radicalisation began during his youth amid the civil war, while his digital footprint revealed an extensive online record featuring conservative and misogynistic commentary. To probe these international connections further, following reports that al-Hammami had been granted an Australian student visa in 2014, authorities in Canberra have initiated an inquiry, according to The Times of Israel.
“The Victorian Joint Counter Terrorism Team (VIC JCTT), comprising the AFP, Victoria Police and ASIO, can confirm it is investigating the man’s links to Australia,” an Australian Federal Police spokesperson stated, according to The Times of Israel, which cited a report from The Guardian. “An update will be provided at an appropriate time,” the spokesperson added.
The Times of Israel report cited sources telling ABC News that the co-pilot was issued a student visa in 2014 and studied in Australia between 2015 and 2017, when he left the country. ABC News also reported that al-Hammami’s student visa was cancelled in 2019 because he was not enrolled in any course.
The Joint Counter Terrorism Team probe will examine whether the co-pilot was radicalised in Australia, the outlet noted, while CNN reported separately that a previously active LinkedIn profile indicated he undertook remote coursework through Buckinghamshire New University in the United Kingdom. (ANI)

Oct 4 : Former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon will testify at a New York City hearing on artificial intelligence, Bloomberg News reported on Sunday, citing people familiar with the matter.
Coxon will appear at the request of New York City Council Speaker Julie Menin, who has urged AI whistleblowers to testify as city lawmakers weigh a package of bills aimed at establishing safeguards around the technology, the report said.
Coxon quit Anthropic last month, issuing warnings that the "people building AI earnestly believe that it could kill us all by the end of the decade" and accusing his former employer and OpenAI of "gambling with our lives."
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.

items.title: HDFC Bank: Anup Bagchi at helm lifts overhang; brokerages share outlook
items.summary: Analysts at Motilal Oswal Financial Services (MOFSL) said Bagchi's appointment removes a key overhang around HDFC Bank's leadership succession.
items.body:
Home / Markets / News / HDFC Bank: Anup Bagchi at helm lifts overhang; brokerages share outlook

HDFC Bank: Anup Bagchi at helm lifts overhang; brokerages share outlook Analysts at Motilal Oswal Financial Services (MOFSL) said Bagchi's appointment removes a key overhang around HDFC Bank's leadership succession.

MOFSL expects the bank’s operating performance to improve from FY28E onward, supported by a recovery in loan growth and margins.Image Credit: Bloomberg

Saloni Goel New Delhi 4 min read Last Updated : Oct 05 2026 | 9:12 AM IST

Listen to This Article

HDFC Bank share price : The Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) nod to Anup Bagchi as the next managing director (MD) and chief executive officer (CEO) for India's largest private lender, HDFC Bank, clears a major leadership overhang and is being seen as a long-term positive for its stock. 
  Bagchi, appointed for a three-year term, would succeed Sashidhar Jagdishan, whose tenure ends on October 26, 2026. An ICICI Bank veteran and current MD & CEO of ICICI Life, Bagchi brings in over three decades of experience across banking, capital markets, wealth management and insurance. READ MORE
  Analysts at Motilal Oswal Financial Services (MOFSL) said the appointment of Bagchi removes a key overhang surrounding HDFC Bank's leadership succession and brings an external perspective at a time when the bank is seeking to rebuild investor confidence. 
 

 

Also Read

Stock Market LIVE: Sensex off 500 points from day's high, Nifty below 22,500; IT, auto shares weigh

HDFC Bank gets new CEO: Stock down 25% thus far in 2026; what charts say?

German Green Steel shares reverse listing gains, down 8% from IPO price

Q2 biz update, ₹17,500-crore fundraise plan drive Bajaj Finance 4% higher

Snapdeal-parent Acevector shares list at nearly 12% discount to IPO price

  Not just poor price performance, HDFC Bank has been marred by corporate governance issues lately, among other issues. The stock has declined 27 per cent so far this year and eroded investor wealth worth ₹4.12 trillion during this period, ACE Equity data shows.   Also Read | HDFC Bank shares rise 2% as Street cheers Anup Bagchi's appointment as CEO
  Management change to aid investor sentiment Emkay Global said that Bagchi should help restore investor and customer confidence in the bank, given that he is a banking veteran with experience across diverse responsibilities within the ICICI Bank group. 

  Moreover, an external appointment could provide  HDFC Bank  with a cleaner slate to reassess its strategy, challenge existing practices and drive a strategic reset. Nomura analysts believe that the pace of execution and clarity on the medium-term growth strategy will be critical for investor confidence and a sustained re-rating. It has a 'Buy' rating and target price of ₹950 on the shares of HDFC Bank, valuing the core bank at 1.9x Mar-28F BVPS of ₹446, with subsidiaries contributing ₹105/share.
  Nuvama Institutional Research said it views the development as a long-term positive; however, blending the distinct ICICI and HDFC Bank organisational DNA could pose near-term challenges with potential management rejig across businesses/subsidiaries. Therefore, rebuilding the leadership team, sustaining growth, bolstering governance and restoring stakeholder confidence would be key priorities, it said. 

  Focus areas & impact on earnings Commenting on the key focus areas, Emkay said over the coming quarters, it sees key priorities for the new MD as: ensuring stability in the upper management; reviving deposit growth; improving the productivity of newer branches; upscaling technological and digital capabilities to match leading peers; and strengthening processes to move beyond past issues, including instances of mis-selling. 
  Overall, MOFSL expects the bank’s operating performance to improve from FY28E onward, supported by a recovery in loan growth and margins. It currently estimates earnings to grow in the mid-teens in FY28E after sluggish trends over FY24-27E. It retained 'Buy' with a target price of ₹925 (1.8x FY28E ABV + ₹128 for subs).

  Scope to re-rate Analysts further see re-rating scope for HDFC Bank amid timely execution on key areas of growth. Analysts at Jefferies said that timely changes to the team (if any) and opportunities from (1) improving retail detail growth, (2) better cross-sell fees, and (3) calibrated re-risking of loan-mix will aid earnings and re-rating from an attractive 1.4x FY28E adj PB. 
  The prolonged underperformance of HDFC Bank shares has also made the valuation attractive, and the stock should see a "sustained re-rating" as the new leadership delivers on key priorities and geopolitical uncertainty-led FPI outflows moderate or reverse, said Emkay Global.
  Disclaimer: Views and outlook shared belong to the respective brokerages/analysts and are not endorsed by Business Standard. Readers' discretion is advised.

items.title: Cowboys stun Texans 34-30 behind CeeDee Lamb, huge second half
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Javonte Williams ran for three touchdowns in the second half and CeeDee Lamb scored on his 17th reception of the game with 40 seconds remaining as the Dallas Cowboys collected a high-voltage 34-30 comeback victory over the host Houston Texans on Sunday afternoon.
items.body:
Javonte Williams ran for three touchdowns in the second half and CeeDee Lamb scored on his 17th reception of the game with 40 seconds remaining as the Dallas Cowboys collected a high-voltage 34-30 comeback victory over the host Houston Texans on Sunday afternoon.
Lamb posted a career-best 17 receptions and totaled 189 yards to help Dallas overcome a 10-point halftime deficit. Jason Witten (18 in 2012) is the only Dallas player to have more receptions in a game.
Dak Prescott completed 32 of 45 passes for 335 yards and Williams had 62 yards on 19 carries for the Cowboys (2-2).
C.J. Stroud was 21-of-31 passing for 347 yards and two touchdowns for the Texans (0-4), who have lost their first four games for the first time since 2020.
Houston's Nico Collins caught seven passes for 118 yards and two scores after a two-game absence due to a hamstring injury. Woody Marks rushed for a score.
Stroud guided the Texans on a nine-play, 87-yard drive to take a 30-27 lead with 2:23 left.
The pivotal play was on third-and-14 from the Dallas 27-yard line. Stroud threw a short pass to tight end Dalton Schultz at the 25. His lateral to David Montgomery was good for 19 more yards to the Cowboys' 6. Marks scored on the next play.
Prescott then drove Dallas 74 yards on 11 plays, eventually connecting with Lamb for the winning points.
Dallas trailed by 10 at the break but KaVontae Turpin opened the third quarter with a 48-yard kickoff return to the Texans' 49. Four plays later, Williams scored on an 8-yard run to bring the Cowboys 16-13.
Houston answered with its own impressive kickoff return as Jaylin Noel went 53 yards to the Dallas 38. Four plays later, Stroud tossed a 22-yard touchdown pass to Collins to give the Texans a 23-13 advantage with 10:50 left in the quarter.
Later in the quarter, Williams scored from the 1 as Dallas pulled within three with 6:49 left.
On their next possession, the Cowboys drove 81 yards on 14 plays with Williams scoring on a 2-yard run to give Dallas its first lead at 27-23 with 11:17 left in the game.
Stroud threw a touchdown pass to Collins and Ka'imi Fairbairn kicked three field goals as the Texans led 16-6 at halftime.
Houston took the opening kickoff and went 85 yards on eight plays. Stroud hit Collins for 45 yards at the outset of the drive and later connected on a 7-yard scoring pass to Collins.
Dallas responded with Brandon Aubrey's 39-yard field goal with 5:10 left before Fairbairn was good from 51 yards to give the Texans a 10-3 advantage with 1:49 remaining.
Aubrey drilled a 50-yard field goal to bring the Cowboys within 10-6 with 12:30 left in the half. Fairbairn added field goals of 39 and 54.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Jameis Winston, Giants outlast Cardinals to move to 3-1
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Jameis Winston tossed three touchdown passes and the New York Giants outlasted the Arizona Cardinals 36-24 on Sunday in East Rutherford, N.J.
items.body:
Jameis Winston tossed three touchdown passes and the New York Giants outlasted the Arizona Cardinals 36-24 on Sunday in East Rutherford, N.J.
Winston overcame two interceptions and four sacks to complete 18 of 29 passes for 250 yards. He found tight end Theo Johnson on an 11-yard connection late in the third quarter for the go-ahead score.
In a back-and-forth game with three lead changes and six turnovers, the Giants (3-1) had to climb out of a 14-3 first-quarter hole.
New York turned things around with Winston's touchdown passes to Malachi Fields and Malik Nabers in the final 4:30 of the first half, which followed the second of three Dominic Zvada field goals. The Giants' halftime lead was cut to 19-17 when the Cardinals' Chad Ryland booted a 60-yard field goal as time expired.
The Cardinals reclaimed the lead midway through the third quarter when Jacoby Brissett found a wide-open Elijah Higgins over the middle for a 2-yard touchdown pass to make it 24-19. But they couldn't come up with any more points as they ventured into Giants territory just once in their final four possessions.
Arizona (1-3) lost its third straight game after a season-opening road win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
Brissett completed 21 of 35 passes for 166 yards with two touchdowns and three interceptions, including a pick-6 on the game's final play.
Giants running back Cam Skattebo ran for a key first down with just over three minutes left to allow New York to take more time off the clock, but the Giants settled for a 52-yard field goal by Zvada with 2:11 to play.
The Cardinals had one more chance.
Deonte Banks was whistled for an 18-yard pass interference call on a pass intended for Marvin Harrison Jr., which moved the Cardinals down to the Giants' 4-yard line with 22 seconds to play. After Brissett threw three straight incomplete passes, Banks redeemed himself on fourth down by intercepting Brissett and returning it 98 yards for a touchdown as the clock ran out.
The Cardinals lost starting offensive tackle Paris Johnson Jr. to injury on the final drive. Earlier in the game, right guard Isaiah Adams and safety Andrew Wingard (knee) were carted off.
--Field Level Media
